name: Yellow Onion Farmer Quality
description:
A 3x3 patch for breeding high-quality yellow onion: each run harvests it, keeps the best in the seed container and replants from it.

Bots:
• Yellow Onion Farmer Quality

In each area:
• Crop Quality(Yellow Onion): till the soil (nothing to build)
• Seeds of crop quality(Yellow Onion): exactly one chest or crate; the best seeds and crops are kept in it (the bot stops without one)

Also needed:
• The Quality grid size option set to "3x3" (Options > Farming).
• Optional: the Seed Trough preset, used when "Keep quality grind containers at most half full" is on.
